parties.respondent: The State Rep. By The Inspector Of Police & Anr.

summary: Quashing criminal proceedings under Section 482 Cr.P.C.; consensual relationship vs rape charges; three incidents admitted; promise of marriage alleged after first intercourse; no initial inducement found; coercive conduct claims inconsistent with repeated hotel visits; abuse of process determined; Prithvirajan precedent applied; proceedings quashed as frivolous.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal proceedings quashed; S.C. No. 49 of 2022 set aside.
